Adds/reduces/multiplies/divides the Peak Performance Time (Aka, the time the ship has before its Combat Readiness starts dropping)
Min 0 - Max 1M
A value greater than 100k (Or 100000) in a ship's PPT will make it "Unlimited" in the Combat Layer
Add/Multiply will add more time to it, Subtract/Divide will remove time from it
Defines the mode of the setting bellow

Adds/reduces/multiplies/divides the Combat Readiness loss per second (Aka, how fast will the Combat Readiness drops per second)
Min 0 - Max 1M
Add/Multiply will make it go down faster, Subtract/Divide will make it slower
Defines the mode of the setting bellow

Adds/reduces/multiplies/divides the Supplies Per Month usage (Aka, how many supplies will it consume in a month)
Min 0 - Max 1M
Add/Multiply increase its usage, Subtract/Divide will decrease its usage
Defines the mode of the setting bellow

Adds/reduces/multiplies/divides the Fuel Usage per lightyear (Aka, how much fuel will it consume by traveling a lightyear in hyperspace)
Min 0 - Max 1M
Add/Multiply increase its usage, Subtract/Divide will decrease its usage
Defines the mode of the setting bellow
